scenes.title: Joe Madden, St. Louis
scenes.description: An explorable St. Louis where Joe Madden, Chief Architect at Moosylvania, keeps his career, client work, resume and contact details. Move through it as a cursor alongside other visitors.

props.name: The moose
body: The Moosylvania moose.

props.name: Welcome sign
body: 2011 to present. Senior Developer to Chief Architect.
Leads all web work with a small team of writers, creatives and developers.

props.name: Cycling track
props.gist: the Carondelicious Criterium and Tuesday night training
body: The park hosts the Carondelicious Criterium and the Tuesday night training series.

props.name: Joe’s bike
body: Joe raced criteriums and still rides. Follow along on Strava.

props.name: Ride sign
body: Longest ride: 160 miles, Ride Across Wisconsin. Longest two-day ride: 235 miles, Ride Across Wisconsin.
Raced criteriums, still rides.

props.name: Marquee
body: Universal Pictures Home Entertainment: three titles, now showing inside.

props.name: MonsterCommerce sign
body: Intern from 2004, full time from 2005 after graduation, left in 2011.
Acquired by Network Solutions, announced December 2005.

props.name: Server rack
props.gist: the e-commerce platform, Shopify before Shopify
body: Built the e-commerce platform: Shopify before Shopify.
After the acquisition, moved to networksolutions.com, focusing on conversion optimisation, front-end development and A/B testing.

scenes.title: Moosylvania, Maplewood
scenes.description: Inside the Moosylvania lobby: the frontend, backend, CMS and data stacks Joe Madden leads as Chief Architect.

props.name: Frontend desk
body: Nuxt, Next, Svelte, modern JavaScript, TypeScript and SCSS.

props.name: Backend desk
body: Node.js/TypeScript and PHP platforms; experience with ASP.NET C#, Ruby and Python.

props.name: CMS desk
body: WordPress, SilverStripe and Strapi; headless Prismic and Storyblok.

props.name: Data desk
body: MySQL, PostgreSQL and Redis; MongoDB experience.

scenes.title: The Foundry, Midtown
scenes.description: Inside the Alamo Drafthouse theatre at City Foundry: three Universal Pictures Home Entertainment games Moosylvania built, on the screen and its posters.

props.name: Screen
props.gist: idle, pick a poster to start a reel
body: The screen plays one reel at a time for everyone in the room. Click a poster to start one.
Fast Five: A find-and-seek and safe-cracking game promoting the home video release.
Snow White and the Huntsman: Multiple mini games built from scenes in the film.
The Lorax: A partnership with Words With Friends.
